title: ANOVA Methods: statistics, psychometrics, and APA reporting for psychology in Python
description: ANOVA Methods is a family of three free and open Python packages for quantitative psychology. psystats provides descriptive statistics, group comparison tables with automatic test selection, inferential tests with effect sizes, linear and logistic regression, and epidemiological risk measures. psymetrics provides reliability analysis, factorability checks, exploratory factor analysis, and confirmatory factor analysis with structural equation models. psyreport renders results from the other two as APA 7 text, LaTeX tables, and Word documents. A documented teaching dataset of 1,957 undergraduate students ships with psystats.
